svg.title: compress-beacon
svg.desc: Learned summary tokens. Gist: a toy 10-position mask where tokens after the gist token G cannot attend to the prompt, so only G's KV needs caching. Activation Beacon: every 1,024-token chunk of Llama-2 leaves 1,024/alpha beacon KVs (128 at alpha = 8) and drops the raw KV. At 128K a Llama-2-7B cache falls from 64 GiB to about 8.5 GiB.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: chunk of w tokens → w / α beacon KVs, raw KV dropped

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: red: after G, prompt P is masked
Activation Beacon · Llama-2, chunk w = 1,024, α = 8
green = 128 beacon KVs per finished chunk
